title: Layer offsets: the §12 example applies the offset in the wrong direction

spec: core_spec.md L6505-6537 (Layer Offset and Scale, §12 example)
core_spec.md L5436-5440 (effective offset converts a layer's time ordinates into the root layer stack's time scale)
core_spec.md L4285-4288 (Sublayers: apply parent scale to child offset/scale, then add the child's offset)
core_spec.md L5483-5487 (Time Codes Per Second: the parent's offset is added)

gap: Spec ambiguity/erratum — §12 computes the sublayer sample time as offset + scale·t (12 → 16) under the reverse (stage→layer) direction, while §10 defines the effective offset as the layer→root affine map; OpenUSD and LightUSD both follow §10 (stage time 12 samples the sublayer at (12−10)/0.5 = 4).

lean.note: Lean model composes the affine maps layer→root (sublayer effective offset ⟨10, 0.5⟩, parent stack identity): a sublayer sample authored at t is presented at stage time 10 + 0.5·t; a stage query at t reads the sublayer at (t − 10)/0.5.
